$ASTS just announced that Europe’s four largest mobile carriers including Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Telefónica and Vodafone are exploring a joint satellite spectrum bid to support direct to phone connectivity across more than 500M subscribers.

What makes this really interesting is AST already has European ground infrastructure in place while dedicated satellite spectrum could allow its BlueBird network to deliver more capacity without relying entirely on the carriers existing cellular frequencies.

And I think this reinforces why the carriers want AST to succeed because they can expand coverage while keeping control of their customers and data rather than becoming dependent on $SPCX Starlink.

quoted.text:
I've been adding to my $ASTS position during this drawdown because rising yields don't change how early we are in building a much larger space economy where satellites become another layer of global telecom infrastructure.

AST already has carrier partnerships giving it access to ~3B potential subscribers and those carriers have every reason to support an alternative to Starlink rather than depend entirely on $SPCX for direct-to-phone connectivity.

The biggest challenge now is scaling to ~45 satellites and turning those partnerships into paying users but with the stock already in a ~70% drawdown I do think a lot of that production and launch risk is being reflected in valuation.

quoted.text:
Super League stockholders have approved every proposal at last week's annual meeting, including:

✅ Issuance of common stock and warrants to Metaplanet
✅ Name change to Superplanet, Inc. ($SLE -> $SUPA)
✅ Increase in authorized preferred shares from 10m to 100m

At closing, Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 BTC + $2.5m USD in exchange for 44.86m common shares, 100 shares of Strategic Alliance Preferred Stock, and common stock warrants representing up to ~$3.4b of potential equity capital.

Based on the ~3.0m Super League shares outstanding as of September 29, Metaplanet would own ~93.7% of Superplanet's common stock at closing. All shares to be held by Metaplanet are subject to a five-year lock-up.

The Strategic Alliance Preferred carries no preferred dividend or liquidation preference; its purpose is governance. While Metaplanet holds it, Metaplanet's consent is required for charter amendments, mergers or changes of control, and designation of a board majority.

As outlined in the proxy, Superplanet intends to grow BTC per share primarily by issuing senior, non-convertible perpetual preferred stock rather than debt.

Metaplanet will also hold a 24-month right to subscribe for up to $210m of unlisted Junior Liquidity Support Preferred Stock. A new chapter begins soon.  🇺🇸🪐

posts.text:
10. Trade Balance

The difference between exports and imports.

A trade surplus means a country exports more, while a trade deficit means it imports more.

posts.name: Compounding Quality
posts.text:
8. Recession

A recession is a period when the economy shrinks instead of grows. 

It leads to job losses and lower spending.

posts.name: Compounding Quality
posts.text:
7. Interest Rates

The cost of borrowing money.

Lower rates encourage spending and investing, while higher rates reduce inflation.

posts.name: Compounding Quality
posts.text:
6. Monetary Policy

Monetary policy involves controlling the money supply and interest rates. 

Central banks use it to manage inflation and keep the economy stable.

posts.name: Brivael Le Pogam
posts.text:
I don't know if you realize what just happened.

Elon Musk is completely bypassing the State.

For 100 years, we've been told the problem is capital. That it must be captured, taxed, redistributed. With an army of intermediaries standing between those who create wealth and the people: ministries, agencies, commissions, bureaucrats.

Musk is doing the opposite. He's taking his capital and giving it directly to the people. One SpaceX share to every kid in America. Not a handout. Not a subsidy. A piece of the machine that's taking humanity to Mars.

And he says it himself: this is the first of many.

Mises understood this back in 1944: the bureaucrat creates nothing. He administers what others created, following rules that have no connection to the value produced. The day value flows directly from the one who creates it to the one who receives it, the bureaucrat has no function left.

That's what's being born right now. A new liberal world order, where the very concept of the State will make less and less sense.

The world we're entering is a world of abundance. AI, robots, energy, space. And that abundance won't come through the State, for one simple reason: we have a century of proof that it doesn't work.

Redistribution was version 1.0. Direct distribution of capital is 2.0.

While France is still debating how to tax builders even more, America is handing stock to its kids.

Pick your side.

Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi on the vision for Krak: one app, one balance, built-in yield, and instant, free cross-border settlement

"Most fintechs are on UI rented on layers. Our goal has been, let's do the hard stuff first. Every layer we own, we can price toward costs and then give that to our customers."

"One app, one balance, like we have for Krak today, and their money in theory never sits idle and never waits for the Monday."

"They can also have agents that work on their behalf. They might not know it's agents, they're just pressing buttons to say please help me with something or I want to be able to get yield."

"You get paid in euros within seconds. It's in your balance in the infrastructure, but it's surfaced as one balance. And then you have access to instant euro payments. It goes across borders in seconds and it costs you nothing. Zero."

"We're not doing any rent extraction. We're able to do it because we're on top of onchain or DeFi liquidity, depending on how it's built out. Because it moves on stablecoin rails today, instead of correspondent banks, you're removing that intermediary."

posts.text:
Token2049 期间，我受邀参加了火币的内部活动，做了一场 panel 分享，也出席了他们的 VIP 晚宴。另外和孙宇晨孙哥@justinsuntron 即兴约了一场采访，目前正在打磨问题。

**先替火币澄清一件事。晚宴原定 6 号，后来因为安排调整改到了 8 号。工作人员是真的尽心尽力，我亲眼看着他们为了协调好每一个人，焦灼地忙了全程。办过活动的人都知道，现场总有太多突发状况：场地临时变更，容纳人数跟着变，这些未知因素导致一些 VIP 没能到场。但团队自始至终都在积极解决问题。

火币的现场活动给我一种很不一样的感觉。在其他交易所的夹击之下，来到现场的反而都是火币多年的老用户，整场氛围其乐融融，非常家人向🙏感谢 @Ceee333_ 的邀请，她是这场活动的负责人之一，也是双语主持，业务能力相当过硬。还有@HTX_Molly @Lumibb_ @Xiaodu_HTX 等火币的小伙伴，每个人都很 energetic。这是我第一次深度接触火币的活动对接团队，评价很高（我不是托，是托死全家）。

**再说说我筹划的这场采访（目前身体太差的确稍微拖延了）。我有稍微看了下孙哥和邵艾伦那场”薄肌”采访，以及和自由潜冠军金明聊 Crypto、AI 与量子威胁的那场。我想问点不太一样的人文向问题，因为我的视角可能有些特别：我是从新概念时期就知道孙哥的。同为新概念作文大赛的获奖者，他某种程度上算是我的前辈。我第一次听到这个名字，是在《萌芽》上读到他写的《一道论证题》，所以对他的文青之路一路追踪非常熟稔。

我也注意到，孙哥提到他们生态里一直比较活跃的以太坊挖矿活动，所以也想专门问问他怎么看 ETH 这个资产。对于BTC被攻破这块，我和以太坊基金会做抗量子研究和在Yale/MIT读相关PHD的一些朋友交流过，他们对 Q-Day 的到来目前还算比较乐观，这个话题也想和他聊聊。

**最后一个小提议：**除了数学奖，火币很值得再设一个文学奖/人文奖。我感觉现在这些交易所办的这种访谈活动，基本上都是跟交易员对谈，来来回回，其实也都是那些交易员，同质化程度太高了，包括打广告的 KOL 也是，基本上是今天做完交易所 A 的广告，明天又去发交易所 B 的广告。孙哥既是新概念出身，又做过社交 App（陪我），某种程度上“薄肌”也算是一种文化输出了，那是否火币可以系统性以活动的形式支持更多元的加密文化输出？

先发散到这儿，抛砖引玉，之后再细聊。

Families say Tesla FSD is changing lives for their family members in their 80s and 90s. ♥️

A 90-year-old man now owns a Model Y after his children recommended it. His neighbor, who works in healthcare, says FSD will help him stay independent.

Other families shared remarkable stories in the comments:

• One said their 92-year-old neighbor bought a Tesla the day after trying FSD.

• Another said their 87-year-old father uses FSD to get almost everywhere, adding: “Great that this gives him additional mobility at his age.”

• A third said their 83-year-old father loves his Model Y and uses FSD for nearly all his driving, helping him attend his grandchildren’s events and enjoy dinners with friends. “It really is transformational.”

For these families, Tesla’s technology means more opportunities to get out, see loved ones and enjoy everyday life. That is what makes FSD’s progress so exciting.
